high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a webpage from ESPNcricinfo.com, specifically the commentary section for a cricket match. The match details indicate it is the 4th Test between India and England, played at The Oval in September 2021 during the India tour of England. The result shows that India won by 157 runs. The commentary section features quotes from Virat Kohli, the Indian captain. He discusses the team's character, mentioning their ability to come back from a 100-run deficit and expressing pride in the performance.
